trial_type.Description: Event category encoding choice or outcome phase, partner type, and reciprocation outcome when applicable.

response_time.Description: Time from investment-choice presentation to the participant's response.

trust_value.Description: Number of dollars from the participant's eight-dollar endowment selected for investment with the partner.

choice.Description: Whether the participant selected the lower or higher displayed investment option.

cLow.Description: Lower of the two investment amounts displayed on the trial.

cHigh.Description: Higher of the two investment amounts displayed on the trial.
